source: Animated dithered mark, rigged from the mark's own pixels: three wingbeats with both wings (near wing swings and foreshortens, far wing tucks behind the neck), a glide with tail flick, tail fan and head nod, then rest; tiny body shiver. 72 frames at 30 fps, 1 px dither cells; drawn at its own 102 px height so the dither stays crisp
